description: Gated production activation of the BMAX dashboard standalone artifact on VPS vps-6d919042. SEPARATE from readiness (VPS_DEPLOYMENT_READINESS) and from release acceptance: this mission is the controlled activation itself (versioned release switch, reverse-proxy + TLS, health-gated cutover, post-deploy acceptance, rollback). HUMAN-GATED and depends on VPS_DEPLOYMENT_READINESS being PROVEN. It involves protected/irreversible host actions (sudo/systemd/DNS/TLS/public exposure) and MUST NOT be executed autonomously. No cloud migration; VPS-only.

objectives.goal: Activate the accepted BMAX dashboard release on VPS behind TLS with a health-gated cutover and a rehearsed rollback.
done_when: The accepted release artifact (a specific commit) is placed under a versioned release layout and the active-version switch points to it.
The service runs with its working directory resolving the LIVE runtime/generated (not the build-time frozen copy).
A reverse proxy terminates TLS and GET /api/health returns 200 READY for N consecutive probes before public exposure.
Post-deploy acceptance passes: /api/runtime-state 200 with real data, real-browser smoke green, no console/page errors.
A rollback drill to the previous release (code + data restore) is demonstrated on the live host.
Monitoring and explicit rollback criteria are active.

authorization.reason: Human-gated: production activation requires an explicit, separate CTO deployment authorization and HOST prerequisites (DNS/TLS/reverse-proxy/service account). Protected and partially irreversible; never self-authorized.

definition_of_done: Public HTTPS URL serves the accepted release with health checks green.
Post-deploy acceptance and a live-host rollback drill are PROVEN.
The deployment is recorded with runtime evidence; no 'deployed' claim without it.
completion: Separate explicit CTO deployment authorization recorded, then Release Manager/operator acceptance with post-deploy evidence.
stop_conditions: Absent explicit CTO deployment authorization, or absent any required HOST prerequisite (DNS/TLS/reverse-proxy/backup), HALT without mutating infrastructure.
rollback: Switch the active-version pointer back to the previous accepted release and restore ODG_CLIENT_STORE from a verified off-release backup; rehearsed before activation.
